typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep chapter text width constrained (max-w-3xl) for comfortable reading. Use tracking-tight for large headings.

visual enhancers.surfaces: Use 1px subtle borders (border-white/5) to separate dark elements instead of heavy shadows.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0C0C0E]/80 border-b border-white/5.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento layout with distinct cards for Projects, Rules, and Credits. Gap-6 or gap-8.
layouts.editor_desktop: 2-column grid. Left: col-span-8 or 7 (Editor text). Right: col-span-4 or 5 (Analysis).
layouts.editor_mobile: Single column layout. Bottom fixed tabs to switch between Editor and Analysis.

components.credit_counter: Pill shape in header: rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-1.5 font-mono text-sm tracking-tight text-white.
components.text_highlights: Inline spans with subtle bg and bottom border. Fact: bg-emerald-500/20 border-b border-emerald-500/50. AI: bg-amber-500/20 border-b border-amber-500/50.
components.analysis_tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Fatos (Green) vs Leitura Crítica (Yellow).
components.sticky_disclaimer: Placed inside 'Leitura Crítica' tab: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 p-3 rounded border border-amber-500/20 text-xs. Content: 'Isto é uma leitura possível, não um veredito'.
components.reliability_badge: Flex row with icon. Verified (PT/EN): text-emerald-400. Generic: text-amber-400.
components.confirmation_modal: Shadcn Dialog. Dark surface bg-[#121215]. Clear typography displaying credit cost before analysis.
components.bottom_tabs: For mobile only. Fixed at bottom. Icons + text labels.

motion.hover: Buttons and cards must have background and border color transitions (duration-200).
motion.tabs: Use framer-motion for smooth tab underline sliding.
motion.modal: Scale and fade-in entrance for the confirmation modal.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on the #0C0C0E background meets APCA standards. Do not use pure black backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/50).

auth_background.description: Dark abstract texture, ideal for an auth screen split layout or hero section background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply Dark Mode design. The entire app should have a very dark gray (#0C0C0E) body background.
Import Lora and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css.
Build a fixed global header that contains the Credit Counter.
Ensure the editor area focuses on typography and spacing. No bounding boxes around the chapter text itself.
Implement language selector in the UI (PT-BR, PT-PT, EN, ES, IT, FR, DE).
The analysis right-sidebar must have two primary tabs. In the Leitura Crítica tab, the disclaimer is mandatory.
Mock the credit deduction flow: Click Analyze -> Show Confirmation Modal with Cost -> Click Confirm -> Mock Loading -> Show Results -> Deduct Credits in header.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
No centered layouts for dense information. Left-align text for readability.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use modern pill-shaped or slightly rounded buttons with explicit hover/active states.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons.
Prioritize Shadcn components; override their fixed heights where content needs to flow.
Include micro-animations for all interactive state changes.
